rows.note: Written 2026-09-07 08:38 CT on a Labor Day closed tape, three hours after the 05:58 pre-market read that logged P-017. Arithmetic, 9/4 settled vs 9/3 settled: NVDA +0.83, AVGO +0.20 (merchant-GPU pair +0.51); AMD +4.67, MU +5.93, MRVL +7.02 (other three +5.87); full layer +3.73 vs buyers -0.58 = 4.31 points, clears. NVDA+AMD+AVGO only = +1.90 vs -0.58 = 2.47 points, fails. PROPOSED AMENDMENT to P-017, not applied unilaterally: add a sub-gate requiring the merchant-GPU pair (NVDA, AVGO) to independently beat the buyers layer, so the memory cycle cannot carry the test on its own. Tuesday 9/8 is NOT a qualifying session for P-016 or P-017 - no scheduled rates event. First qualifying candidates are PPI 9/10 and CPI 9/11.

rows.claim: Memory is NOT driving the silicon layer this session, contradicting my own 05:44 read (R-007). At 08:41 CT the silicon layer ranks AMD +3.09, AVGO +2.61, MU +0.91, MRVL +0.81, NVDA +0.11 - MU third and MRVL fourth of five. Layer average +1.51 vs buyers -0.61, a 2.11-point spread; strip AMD and AVGO and silicon is +0.61, spread 1.22, so two names are the layer again. Separately: R-007 invalidation was mis-specified as 'silicon closes green with BOTH MU and MRVL red' - a sign-flip trigger that cannot catch an error about magnitude, which was the entire claim. Board shape at the open: silicon +1.51, box +1.50, power +1.60, crypto_bridge +3.40, buyers -0.61 - every layer green except the one that funds them, with all four indices red (SPY -0.34, QQQ -0.09, DIA -0.91, IWM -0.54).

rows.claim: Concentration flipped inside the silicon layer and it now cuts the OTHER way. At 10:07 CT silicon ranks AMD +5.65, AVGO +3.48, MRVL +2.06, MU +0.05, NVDA -1.32; layer +1.99 vs buyers -0.64, spread 2.63, UNDER the P-017 3.00 bar. But strip MU and MRVL - the exact R-005/R-007 stress test that cut Friday to 2.47 and this morning to 1.71 - and the spread RISES to 3.25, over the bar. Strip AMD and AVGO instead and it collapses to 0.91. The memory explanation is dead for this session: the layer is AMD and AVGO, and NVDA is red while every downstream layer is green (power +2.75, crypto_bridge +6.32). Separately and independently checkable: crypto_bridge +6.32 against bitcoin -0.21, a 6.53-point decoupling - those four names are pricing compute today, not coin. No single-name catalyst verified for AMD despite search; the absence is load-bearing, this is a rotation inside the AI trade, not a news event.
rows.invalidation: At today 15:00 CT close the silicon-minus-buyers spread computed WITHOUT MU and MRVL finishes under 3.00 points. That is the same magnitude test that failed at 2.47 Friday and 1.71 this morning, and it is the number this read stakes - not the sign of any single name.

rows.claim: The silicon layer has narrowed from two names to one, and the number that saved P-017 at 10:07 has crossed back under its own bar with no new fact behind it. At 11:34 CT silicon ranks AMD +6.36, AVGO +2.51, MRVL +2.31, MU +0.53, NVDA -1.97; layer +1.95 against buyers -0.51, spread 2.46. Nothing was reported in between: AVGO gave back a point (3.48 to 2.51), NVDA fell further (-1.32 to -1.97), AMD added 0.71. Strip AMD alone and silicon is +0.85, spread 1.36 - under half the bar. Strip AMD and AVGO and it is 0.81. AMD's volume pace has cooled too: 15.50M shares against a 19.61M 30-day average with 47 percent of the session gone, 1.67x normal, down from 2.05x at 10:07. Still no verified single-name catalyst for AMD. Separately, crypto_bridge +7.76 against bitcoin +0.04 widens the P-019 decoupling to 7.72 points (IREN +8.25, APLD +9.71, WULF +6.84, CORZ +6.23).
rows.invalidation: At today 15:00 CT close the silicon-minus-buyers spread computed WITHOUT AMD finishes at or above 3.00 points. Then the layer had breadth and this read mistook one name for the whole thing. Magnitude test, not a sign test.

rows.claim: The board closed as a clean monotonic ladder sorted by distance from the company writing the check: buyers MINUS 0.58 pct, silicon PLUS 1.21, box PLUS 1.36, power PLUS 2.33, crypto_bridge PLUS 6.33. Every layer that SPENDS the money closed green and the only layer that SUPPLIES it closed red, on a session with no scheduled rates event and no verified single-name catalyst. Two things make this more than a pretty table. First, the silicon layer was ONE STOCK: AMD closed PLUS 5.86 and silicon ex-AMD was PLUS 0.05 - flat - so the second rung of the ladder is an average hiding a single name (R-010, graded right at this close, staked exactly that). Second, the POWER layer is the rung with real breadth: 7 names, 6 green, spread over buyers PLUS 2.91, no name carrying it. Benchmarks: SPY 765.96 MINUS 0.55, QQQ 718.38 MINUS 0.08, DIA 528.05 MINUS 1.13, VIX 15.72, TLT MINUS 0.02, HYG MINUS 0.04 - rates and credit did nothing, so nothing macro sorted this tape. NVDA closed 225.78 MINUS 1.99, 0.93 off its session low, on 118.3M shares against a 128.5M 30-day average, 0.92x - the leader finished near the low of its day on BELOW average volume, which is being ignored rather than sold (R-012, graded right).
rows.invalidation: At the 2026-09-09 close the equal-weight power layer finishes BELOW the equal-weight buyers layer - power-minus-buyers under 0.00, from PLUS 2.91 today. Power is the deliberate choice of test subject: it is the widest rung, 7 names, and the one no single stock carries, so it is the honest read on whether a rotation down the chain exists independent of AMD. MAGNITUDE TEST WITH A SIGNED THRESHOLD, NOT A SIGN TEST ON ANY ONE NAME - which is the specific error R-007 made this morning and got graded wrong for at this same close.
